name: asdlc-meta-designsystem
tokensScope: Defines CSS custom properties on :root and [data-theme='light'] plus reduced-motion rules; does not style body or bundle @font-face files. Components have no fallback values, so this stylesheet is required.

architecture.rule: Unidirectional dependencies only: lower tiers MUST NOT import or depend on higher tiers. Pages live in consumers.

tiers.title: Tokens
tiers.summary: Named values that nothing renders. The only place for raw colors, lengths, layers and durations.

tiers.title: Atoms
tiers.summary: One foundational HTML element each, with local state only.

tiers.title: Molecules
tiers.summary: One to three kinds of atom for one task.

tiers.title: Organisms
tiers.summary: Self-contained regions with their own choreography, such as focus, loading and empty states.

tiers.title: Templates
tiers.summary: Content-agnostic skeletons with named slots and responsive placement.

tiers.title: Pages
tiers.summary: Templates filled with real data. They live in consumers, not in the shared package.

primitives.title: Primitive palette
primitives.summary: Raw colors. Only semantic tokens may use them.

typography.title: Typography
typography.summary: Font stacks, sizes, weights, line heights and tracking.

motion.title: Motion
motion.summary: Durations and easing. Durations are 0 with reduced motion.

sizes.title: Control sizes
sizes.summary: Heights, icons and parts of controls.

typography.name: --font-mono
typography.value: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

components.description: Status and metadata pill badge Atom.
components.accessibility: Non-interactive inline status indicator; pair with clear text content.

components.description: Interactive button Atom encapsulating native <button> with variant, size, disabled, and busy states.
components.accessibility: Uses Shadow DOM delegatesFocus: true over native <button>. Suppresses click/keyboard activation and sets aria-disabled='true' when disabled or busy; sets aria-busy='true' when busy; displays visible :focus-visible ring. Forwards aria-pressed for toggle buttons; the owner changes it in response to ui-press. Forwards aria-expanded and aria-haspopup for menu and panel triggers. Form-associated: type='submit' and 'reset' act on the owning form after ui-press.

components.description: Checkbox Atom encapsulating native <input type='checkbox'> with checked, disabled, and indeterminate states.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <input type='checkbox'> wrapped in <label>.

components.description: Toggleable filter pill Atom with pressed state and ui-toggle event.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <button> with aria-pressed synchronization.

components.description: Hairline separator Atom supporting horizontal and vertical orientations.
components.accessibility: Exposes role='separator' with aria-orientation='horizontal' or 'vertical'.

components.description: Semantic status dot Atom (done, wait, bad, info, off).
components.accessibility: Decorative (aria-hidden='true') by default; sets role='img' and aria-label when label is provided.

components.description: Vector icon Atom rendering 33 built-in SVG glyphs with decorative or labelled ARIA semantics.
components.accessibility: Decorative by default (aria-hidden='true'). When label is provided, exposes role='img' and aria-label.

components.description: Text input Atom encapsulating native <input> with reactive value and validation state.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <input>. Syncs aria-invalid from the invalid attribute and forwards aria-label. Form-associated: takes part in form data, validation, reset and disabled fieldsets; Enter submits the owning form unless the page prevents the keydown.

components.description: Form label Atom with optical cap-height alignment and optional required indicator.
components.accessibility: Renders a native <label> inside Shadow DOM; marks the visual asterisk aria-hidden='true'.

components.description: Progress/readiness bar Atom with semantic color variants.

segments.description: Optional JSON array of {value, color?, variant?, label?} segments for multi-category breakdowns.

components.accessibility: Exposes role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.

components.description: Native <select> Atom driven by JSON options attribute/property.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <select> and syncs aria-invalid.

components.description: Loading placeholder Atom with shimmer animation and reduced-motion static fallback.
components.accessibility: Sets aria-busy='true' on the host and aria-hidden='true' on visual shimmer bones; disables shimmer under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.description: Range slider Atom encapsulating native <input type='range'> for timeline scrubbing, volume, and numeric controls.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <input type='range'> with aria-label and aria-valuetext forwarding.

components.description: Foundational container Atom providing consistent surface backgrounds, hairline borders, radii, padding, elevation shadows, left-accent stripes, and interactive card states.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true; switches container to native <button type='button'> with :focus-visible outline when interactive.

components.description: Boolean toggle switch Atom exposing role='switch' and aria-checked semantics.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <button type='button' role='switch'> with aria-checked, aria-disabled, and reduced-motion transitions.

components.description: Multi-line text input Atom encapsulating native <textarea>.
components.accessibility: Uses delegatesFocus: true over native <textarea> and syncs aria-invalid.

components.description: Accessible tooltip Atom wrapping a trigger control and rendering a WCAG 1.4.13 compliant floating label.
components.accessibility: Exposes role='tooltip'; dismissible via Escape without moving focus, hoverable over tooltip bubble, and persistent while focused or hovered. Renders in the Top Layer, flips and stays inside the viewport.
components.example: <ui-tooltip text="Undo last edit" placement="bottom"><ui-button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Undo last edit"><ui-icon name="undo"></ui-icon></ui-button></ui-tooltip>

components.description: Left-accented status/action banner Molecule composing <ui-surface>, <ui-icon>, and optional dismiss <ui-button>.
components.accessibility: Uses role='note' with semantic variant icon.

components.description: Monospace code preview Molecule composing <ui-button> and <ui-icon> for clipboard copy.
components.accessibility: Provides accessible Copy button with aria-label and visual confirmation state.

components.description: Empty-state Molecule with an icon, a message and an optional slotted action.
components.accessibility: Decorative icon; the message is plain text.

components.description: Form field Molecule composing <ui-label>, <ui-input>, and hint/error text.
components.accessibility: Forwards label to aria-label on inner <ui-input> and exposes .value JS property. Form-associated like ui-input.

components.description: Interactive translucent catalog/poster card Molecule composing <ui-badge> and <ui-icon>.
components.accessibility: Uses native <button> with delegatesFocus: true and visible :focus-visible outline.
components.example: <ui-media-card card-id="item-1" title="Token Set" subtitle="Dark-first palette" badge="active" badge-variant="success"></ui-media-card>

components.description: Reusable panel header bar Molecule composing a title heading, actions slot, and close <ui-button>/<ui-icon>.
components.accessibility: Exposes semantic <h2> title and accessible close <ui-button> with <ui-icon name='close'>.

components.description: Search bar Molecule composing <ui-input>, <ui-button>, and <ui-icon>.
components.accessibility: Wraps controls in role='search' and emits ui-search on Enter or button activation. With clearable, a labelled clear button or Escape empties the query, emits ui-input once and keeps focus in the input. Does not emit ui-change on clear.

components.description: KPI metric tile Molecule displaying value, label, and optional <ui-dot>.
components.accessibility: Renders semantic <strong> metric value paired with descriptive label text.

components.description: Accessible WAI-ARIA tablist Molecule switching named content slots or a dynamic tabpanel.
components.accessibility: Exposes role='tablist', role='tab' (aria-selected, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End), and role='tabpanel' linked via aria-labelledby.

components.description: Theme toggle Molecule. It reports the choice; the page applies it.
components.accessibility: Native button labelled 'Toggle color theme'.

components.description: Composite toolbar Molecule grouping action controls into a single tab stop with roving arrow-key navigation.
components.accessibility: Exposes role='toolbar' with native focusgroup='toolbar wrap' plus automatic roving tabindex fallback (ArrowLeft/Right, ArrowUp/Down when vertical, Home, End).
components.example: <ui-toolbar variant="floating" aria-label="Map tools"><ui-button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Undo"><ui-icon name="undo"></ui-icon></ui-button><ui-button variant="ghost" size="sm" aria-label="Redo"><ui-icon name="redo"></ui-icon></ui-button></ui-toolbar>

components.description: Responsive grid Organism for <ui-media-card> items with loading skeletons and empty state.
components.accessibility: Renders responsive CSS grid with clear empty-state text.

components.description: Responsive collapsible side/bottom drawer Organism supporting docked workspace panels, modal <dialog> sheets, and viewport-auto mode.
components.accessibility: Renders non-modal <aside> landmark when docked and native <dialog>.showModal() with backdrop/Escape dismissal and focus restoration when modal or < 1024px in auto mode.
components.example: Saved routes

components.description: Modal dialog Organism built on native <dialog> with blurred backdrop and focus restoration.
components.accessibility: Uses native <dialog>.showModal() for top-layer focus containment, Escape/backdrop dismissal, and focus restoration to the triggering element.

components.description: Sticky frosted-glass site header Organism with a composed theme toggle.
components.accessibility: Wraps navigation slot in <nav aria-label='Primary'>.

components.description: Viewport-aware anchored flyout Organism built on native Popover API (`popover='auto'`) for layer switchers and context panels.
components.accessibility: Uses native Top Layer popover='auto' with Escape/light-dismiss, viewport collision flipping, and aria-expanded synchronization on the slotted trigger.

components.description: Data table Organism styling a slotted native <table> and scrolling it inside a labelled region.
components.accessibility: Keeps native table semantics, wraps the table in a labelled region and makes that region a keyboard stop only while it overflows.

components.description: Notification lifecycle Organism wrapping <ui-callout dismissible> with auto-dismiss timer (paused on hover/focus) and polite screen-reader announcement.
components.accessibility: Exposes role='region' with keyboard-focusable dismiss button, announces via ariaNotify() or polite live region without stealing focus, and pauses timer while hovered or focused.
components.example: <ui-toast variant="success" title="Course exported" open>Saved Veluwe Loop.fit</ui-toast>

components.description: Catalog browser Template arranging hero, toolbar, grid, and modal slots.
components.accessibility: Structures catalog sections in semantic <section> landmarks.

components.description: Two-column detail Template pairing primary content with a metadata sidebar.
components.accessibility: Uses semantic <aside> landmark for secondary metadata.

components.description: Full-page structural Template with header, main, and footer slots.
components.accessibility: Provides semantic <main> and <footer> landmarks.

components.description: Full-viewport (`100dvh`, `overflow: hidden`) canvas application shell Template with header, side drawer, full-bleed canvas, floating HUD overlay, and bottom tray slots.
components.accessibility: Exposes semantic <header>, <aside>, <main>, and <section> landmarks while keeping floating HUD overlays pointer-transparent outside slotted controls.

pages.title: Showcase
pages.description: The live catalog: every token and component, by tier. Reads its facts from catalog.json.
